name: todoevents
description: Find published Todo-Events listings and prepare public event listings for organizer review and confirmed publication.

interface.shortDescription: Find events and share public happenings
interface.longDescription: Search current published Todo-Events listings by area, date, and category, with canonical event links. Organizers can prepare and review a public listing, then explicitly confirm publication through their connected organizer account. Private invitations, ticket checkout, and paid upgrades are outside this plugin's scope.
defaultPrompt: Find published community events for this weekend in an area I choose.
Help me review a public listing for my community event.
